content:
{'index': 0, 'original': '「Find My」app is used by millions of people to locate lost devices in moments of crisis, and even more to share their location with friends and family in real time.', 'translation': '「尋找」App 獲數以百萬計用戶用來在緊急時刻尋找遺失的裝置，亦有更多用戶透過它與親朋好友分享即時位置。'}

{'index': 1, 'original': 'The iOS 27 software update brings a set of changes that holistically improve the Find My experience. Specifically, iPhone users who routinely leave their phone behind to go for walks with just their Apple Watch will automatically benefit from smarter location sharing...', 'translation': 'iOS 27 系統更新加入了一系列改動，全面提升「尋找」體驗。具體而言，習慣只佩戴 Apple Watch 外出散步的 iPhone 用戶，將自動享有更智能的位置分享功能……'}

{'index': 2, 'original': 'In iOS 26 and earlier, location sharing in Find My relied entirely on a single device. You could choose one device in Find My settings to broadcast your location, and that was it. For most people, that device was their iPhone.', 'translation': '在 iOS 26 及更早版本中，「尋找」的位置分享完全依賴單一裝置。用戶可在「尋找」設定中選擇一部裝置作為定位來源，僅此而已。對大多數人來說，這部裝置就是他們的 iPhone。'}

{'index': 3, 'original': "So your position on the Find My map would update based on where your iPhone actually was. But for users who leave their phone at home and rely heavily on their Apple Watch, this wasn't very practical.", 'translation': '因此，你在「尋找」地圖上的位置，會隨着 iPhone 的實際位置而更新。但對於習慣將手機留在家中、重度使用 Apple Watch 的用戶而言，這種運作方式並不實用。'}

{'index': 4, 'original': "iOS 27 changes that. Now, if you use Find My on your phone and have an Apple Watch paired, Find My will automatically use the watch's location when it's not near your iPhone. That means your shared location will proactively update to reflect where you really are.", 'translation': 'iOS 27 為此帶來改善。現在，如果你在手機上使用「尋找」並已配對 Apple Watch，當手錶不在 iPhone 附近時，「尋找」將自動採用手錶的位置。這意味着位置分享會主動更新，以反映你真正的所在位置。'}

{'index': 5, 'original': 'Automatic location sharing is supported on both the standard and cellular Apple Watch models, but the cellular version can obviously relay location info to the Find My network more consistently.', 'translation': 'Apple Watch 的標準版及流動網絡版均支援自動位置分享功能，但流動網絡版手錶顯然能夠更穩定地將位置資訊傳送至「尋找」網絡。'}

{'index': 6, 'original': 'watchOS 27 also brings a major overhaul to the Find My app on Apple Watch. The previously separate Find Items, Find People, and Find Device apps have been consolidated into a single, new Find My app. The new app features a redesigned user interface with a full-screen map layout, allowing users to easily switch between items by turning the Digital Crown.', 'translation': 'watchOS 27 同樣為 Apple Watch 上的「尋找」App 帶來大改版。過往分開的「尋找物品」、「尋找人物」及「尋找裝置」App 已被整合，統一為全新的「尋找」App。新版 App 採用煥然一新的用戶介面，設有全螢幕地圖布局，用戶只需轉動數碼錶冠即可輕鬆在不同項目之間切換。'}

{'index': 7, 'original': 'iOS 27 and watchOS 27 are currently in beta and will launch as free updates for all users this fall, expected in September.', 'translation': 'iOS 27 及 watchOS 27 目前處於測試階段，將於今年秋季（預計為九月）以免費更新形式正式向所有用戶推出。'}
